issues.description: The initial desktop menu occupies a narrow central strip and leaves a large amount of unused screen area above, below, and to both sides, making the interface feel underbuilt rather than intentionally framed.
Tablet repeats the same overly small centered cluster as desktop, with excessive empty margins that weaken presence and make the menu feel like a mockup instead of a finished gameplay-scaled UI.

Play is taller than the secondary buttons, but the dominance is modest; Settings and Credits remain visually too similar in width, finish, and contrast, so the primary CTA is not unmistakable at first glance.
The menu stack sits a bit low relative to the full frame, creating more empty space beneath the buttons than the title-to-top spacing justifies and making the composition feel slightly adrift.

The mobile layout reads as a uniform shrink of the desktop composition with limited thumb-zone adaptation; the dock is still visually centered instead of more deliberately bottom-weighted for handheld use.
Inside Settings, the right edge logic is inconsistent: the close button, toggle, and 70% value do not resolve to a clean shared inset, which makes the panel internals feel slightly hand-placed.
The volume row feels cramped vertically relative to the panel size; the label, value, and slider are packed together while there is still open panel area lower down.
Credits body text is low-contrast against the bright panel surface and reads washed out, especially compared with the strong white title.
The Credits panel is appropriately smaller than Settings, but the body area is visually empty after the first line, making the panel feel oversized for its content.
The Settings panel is readable, but the close button and slider handle feel visually delicate against the ornate frame for fast in-game touch interaction.

repairInstructions: Enlarge the hero menu on desktop and tablet so the title and buttons claim more of the safe area; keep the same centered stack and artwork family, but reduce the accidental dead space.
Make Play clearly more dominant than Settings and Credits through stronger height, slightly richer gold emphasis, and/or more separation from the secondary buttons without adding new features.
Reposition the mobile stack lower within the safe area to better support thumb reach instead of simply centering the desktop arrangement.
Tighten internal alignment in Settings by giving the close button, toggle, slider, and numeric value a shared right inset and clearer row geometry.
Increase vertical spacing in the Settings content block so the volume section breathes and reads as a deliberate second row.
Raise the contrast of Credits body text substantially; preserve live text and panel skin, but switch the copy color closer to the panel title/body palette target.
Reduce the apparent emptiness of the Credits panel by either shrinking the panel height slightly or vertically centering/tightening the body region around the existing text.
Keep the current cyan/cobalt/navy/gold skin family, title plate treatment, and matching icon family; the repair should be targeted at layout and readability, not a full visual reset.

preserve: Preserve the glossy cyan/cobalt artwork family with navy edges and gold highlights across title plate, buttons, and panels.
Preserve the matching icon family for Play, Settings, Credits, and both Close buttons.
Preserve the required feature set exactly: Play, Settings, Credits, Settings modal controls, and Credits modal only.
Preserve the small subordinate scale of the Credits panel relative to the Settings panel.
modify: Modify MainMenuDock, TitlePlate, PlayButton, SettingsButton, and CreditsButton sizing/placement on desktop and tablet to occupy more of the safe area and reduce dead zones.
Modify PlayButton styling and spacing so it reads as the unmistakable primary CTA over the two secondary menu actions.
Modify the mobile MainMenuDock vertical position and spacing to create a more thumb-friendly lower-weighted arrangement.
Modify SettingsModal internal layout so SettingsCloseButton, MusicToggle, VolumeValue, and VolumeSlider align to consistent insets.
Modify spacing within the Volume row to add breathing room between VolumeLabel, VolumeValue, and VolumeSlider.
Modify CreditsBody color and/or subtle shadow treatment to achieve stronger contrast against the bright panel skin.
Modify CreditsModal height or body placement so the content area feels intentionally sized rather than half-empty.
add: Add stronger visual emphasis to PlayButton through scale, spacing, or gold crest treatment while keeping the same button skin family.
Add a more deliberate internal grid/inset system for panel content so labels and right-side controls share consistent anchors.
